name: Kerglas
text: Kerglas is the name of a castle in the Breton folk-tale of Peronnik. The fortress is the home of an evil magician. This sorcerer has stolen the lance of the tale. Peronnik must enter Kerglas to win the weapon back.

key_results: Name the castle of the tale.
Name the magician who holds the lance.
Set the castle in Breton story.
